# Ready Windows executable runtime notices

The ready EXEs were built with LLVM-MinGW 20261104 (Clang 23.1.5) and statically linked C/C++ runtime support. These are the accompanying LLVM and MinGW-w64 runtime notices from that toolchain. No BarTender or printer driver binaries are distributed.

Toolchain source: https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/tag/20261104
